tasks.title: Tile-aligned bbox pulls in extra lidar tiles (new-world-build skill and tiles_for)
tasks.notes: 2026-10-28, Sheffield bootstrap: bbox-mc 430000,-390000,440000,-385000 (exactly tile-aligned, 2 tiles intended) fetched 6 tiles / 12 downloads (about 900 MB, not 300 MB). Cause: defra_lidar.tiles_for adds 1 m east and north for bilinear corners, so a box ending exactly on a tile edge reaches the next tile column and row. Not a bug in tiles_for, but the new-world-build skill promises 1 tile (aligned) / 2 / 4 and never says to end an aligned box 1 m inside the upper edge (e.g. x1=439998). Fix: say so in the skill section 0 and the tile-count step, or have lidar_extremes warn when the box ends on a tile edge and print the tile count before fetching.
